# Development on Ethereum

A hands-on path from your first line of Solidity to shipping production-ready smart contracts, covering language fundamentals, security, tooling, proxies, randomness, token standards, and the patterns behind real DeFi protocols. Through milestone projects you'll learn to write code that doesn't just work, it holds up when the network turns hostile.
